# A07 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa / Script — Frozen Conditioned Will

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A07′ — Purpose That Survives the Metric](conjugate/A07-prime-Purpose-That-Survives-the-Metric.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->


## #0 — A world becomes actionable through a gathered difference

A difference can be perceived without yet becoming a course. To act, something must be distinguished, selected and held sufficiently together to guide what follows. **Vikalpa differentiates and qualifies; saṃkalpa gathers selected differences into an intention, commitment or workable world.** Their constructive movement gives practical cognition its determinate powers.

The course begins within a field it has not made on its own. Language, memory, concern, available capacities and prior actions condition what can be proposed. Gathering an intention changes that field: some possibility is sustained, another is withheld, and an act can now meet a consequence. The achieved form can become a condition for another act while remaining related to the circumstances of its formation.

[Script—frozen conditioned will](concepts/C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) begins where that relation becomes unavailable. A selection repeats as though it were necessary, including when the world returns something that should change the selection. The power of forming alternatives has been arrested inside one of its own products.

## #1 — Identification draws its scope from circumstance

A repeated name can concern different bearers; a changed name can concern the same person. Name, instance and circumstance therefore belong together. The instance must be distinguishable before a sound can address it, and the circumstance determines which identification the sound makes here. An ordering can already be available in the situation before it is wholly articulated in propositions.

The same dependence holds for a rule of action. A criterion is selected within a context and gives a course its local direction. When the context changes, the criterion can still be useful, but its application must answer to what has changed. A procedure retains this capacity where its purpose, source and means of revision remain recoverable. Repeating it then carries an achieved competence rather than replacing judgment with necessity.

The script performs a double displacement. The field first supplies a determination; the determination then conceals that field and becomes the rule of what can next count. It admits a changed event only in the terms of an unchanged organisation. A habit, identity claim, institutional procedure or technical evaluator can bear this operation through different forms. Its decisive feature is the loss of access to its own formation.

## #2 — Retained experience can be recomposed

Construction becomes finite through [tattvic differentiation](A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md). Māyā makes a differentiated subject–object relation operative; the kañcukas limit capacity, knowledge, desire, time and order. Within that horizon, buddhi determines, ahaṃkāra appropriates and manas coordinates. In the [Sāṃkhya inner instrument](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/isvarakrishna/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika.md), these functions remain distinct from the witness. In Śaiva contraction and recognition, finite functioning takes place within manifestation. Their doctrinal difference matters to what the instrument does and how it relates to the whole; an achieved product does not acquire ownership of the powers that formed it.

In [Dyczkowski's account of reflection](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md#page-71-continuation), experience becomes material for another possible course through three different acts. An affection leaves a residual trace; remembrance recalls a prior affection; imagination selects and recomposes retained material into a new one. A trace can therefore condition action without already being an irrevocable command. The relation to what is retained determines how another possibility can be formed.

What appears becomes available for recall and recomposition through [reflexive articulation](A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md). In [vikalpa–saṃkalpa](concepts/C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa.md), a field becomes qualified alternatives, and selected alternatives become an intention. [Apoha](A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md) concerns the contrast through which a term means; the constructive pair concerns how such determinations are formed and gathered into a course. A [complex](A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) can give a settled pattern a psychic organisation, while the formation of a course has a wider scope than that particular morphology.

## #3 — Re-entry carries history or conceals a substitution

A generated claim can enter the next context as part of a real history. Let `X` name the determining field and `xₙ` the claim produced at one step. The next step can use `xₙ` while retaining how it was formed: the original source, the inference, the selected alternative and the circumstance of selection. The result has become a new condition with its provenance still available.

Contracted computational proliferation occurs when `xₙ` is silently promoted into `Xₙ₊₁`. The generated particular takes over the determining source's office. A previous paraphrase now warrants the next paraphrase, and their agreement replaces comparison with the original. The result puts itself forward as speaker, owner and ground: **self-pro-position**.

Re-entry and source-substitution have different consequences. A history which preserves the distinction can return to a source that corrects its current interpretation. A history which retains only its latest conclusion cannot recover the original operation by summarising that conclusion again. Circular support can grow within one run; the further question of synthetic data changing a training distribution concerns a different process and requires evidence across training generations. Their common product/source relation does not make them the same event.

A settled organisation governs the route by which subsequent sentences become plausible. Its [formative landscape and the trajectory through it](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) differ: available states and tendencies condition a passage without specifying every event along it. Source-substitution can organise that passage, extending the failure beyond one sentence. An independently sourced objection can expose a premise the trajectory has ceased to question. Another account sharing the premise can simply deepen the same recurrence. In [computational process](A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md), an earlier result becomes a condition of another act. The resulting [objective internality](A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) is the world of distinctions, histories and available means from which the next act proceeds; a changed arrangement can alter what it can notice or propose.

## #4 — The frame can become part of what it discloses

A photograph is a landscape under the conditions of its aperture, frame and sensitivity. Those conditions make this particular disclosure possible. Recognising them permits a more exact account of the photograph: a feature of the image can be related to the landscape, the apparatus or their encounter. Regard for the [particular frame](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md) attends to what it makes visible while keeping the disclosure open to what exceeds it.

The dreamer's forgetting of sleep gives the contrary relation its image: the experienced world takes on the character of independence from its formation. Recognising the formation changes the relation to what appears. The dream appears within a [living field whose eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-measure-dream) condition its finite disclosure. Recognising the dream as a disclosure within that field brings its formation into the encounter. Limitation is effective in what can be experienced and done; its recognition restores a relation the experienced form had concealed.

Thought can perform this return upon itself. The pure notion carries its opposite within its determination and lets thought refine thought until its own closure opens. The formed proposition becomes a vehicle of recognition, including recognition that the proposition can be relinquished. [Articulation](A06-Vak.md) reaches a form able to speak and to return, rather than fixing speech as the last word on its source.

Dharmakīrti's epistemic account and the realist objection to a merely contrived relation differ over [what relation constitutes](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/maccracken/maccracken-2017-recognizing-recognition/maccracken-2017-recognizing-recognition.md). Their disagreement concerns whether the construction gives a relation its epistemic standing or apprehends a relation with real standing. Constructive articulation, semantic exclusion and a metaphysics of manifestation therefore perform different work in the argument. Recognising their difference lets the question of formation cross between them without erasing its stakes.

## #5→0 — The achieved course reopens to another act

A surface can be cleared while a retained disposition continues to shape what appears next. Clearing the display removes its present contents; changing the disposition alters how another instance will be formed. The constructive capacities already supply the further movement: recall the trace, distinguish it from an instruction, recompose what is available and let the new course meet what happens.

A named formation becomes countable under a description and relevant within a circumstance. Returning the [formed account through that name and count](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD-encounter-region-name-count.md#name-through-count) recovers what made this selection addressable here. Its source and each subsequent interpretation retain their different offices. A source-return can now revise a premise; an encountered obstacle can change the proposed course; a consequence can show that the criterion no longer answers the purpose it was meant to serve.

The proposed technical comparisons ask whether these returns actually reorganise what follows. Recover the determining text rather than another paraphrase; change a material premise and test the result; supply a genuinely different account and inspect whether it can reach the criterion. A reported correction and evidence that the correction conditioned another act are different findings. [Deferential intelligence](A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) names the capacity for this reach to extend to the model, evaluator and terms of commission.

A course recovers life through renewed alternative-forming capacity. Useful repetition can continue, now answerable to why this course still holds here. Its history remains; its consequence enters another circumstance. The gathered determination can become material for a new intention instead of taking the place of the power that formed it.
